newsitem.title: USA: No limits on Dec crude shipments on ARCO line 63.
newsitem.headline: No limits on Dec crude shipments on ARCO line 63.

text.p: ARCO pipeline set no limits on crude oil shipments on California's Line 63 for December, a company spokesman said Friday.
This marks the second time since a January 1994 earthquake knocked out out a companion line that Arco has not prorationed the line, the spokesman said.
"Unlike previous months, all nominations on the pipeline will be shipped," said the company.
The line 63, which carries crude oil from the San Joaquin Valley in central California to the Los Angeles basin, has a 120,000 barrel per day (bpd) designed capacity.
In November, the pipeline was at a 60.82 percent prorationing and has lately been carrying about 107,000 bpd of light and heavy crudes, said the spokesman.
